Ari: Quick follow-up from today's leader panel — promised clearer timelines for API, Console, and Optimize. I'll drop the concrete bits here and @Leah will add rollout notes.

Leah: API gen2 (streaming perf + function-calling stability) -> internal canary next week, broader canary for partners in 3 weeks, GA ~6 weeks. Notable: streaming change may need small client-side SDK tweaks.

Samir: Can you clarify compatibility? If customers pin model versions, will gen2 be opt-in?

Leah: Yes — gen2 will be opt-in by default for existing pinned versions. We'll provide a compatibility flag `api_version=gen2` and automatic fallback to gen1 on mismatch. No forced migration.

Priya: For Dedicated/Private customers, does this require any infra changes or will it be a control-plane option? We had questions from finance about SLA implications.

Leah: Dedicated: control-plane rollout first, then we push a node-level runtime update. Private (VPC/on-prem) customers can schedule the runtime upgrade; we'll ship a delta package and a migration checklist. SLA is unchanged during canary; GA will carry the usual update notices.

Diego: Console updates: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, and rollout config UI for canaries. Beta starts April 14 for internal + selected partners, public opt-in beta mid-May, GA end of Q2. Console will show rollout states and quick rollback buttons.

Nina: A couple dev notes — streaming change touches the server push framing. SDKs (python/js) need minor tweaks: `client.stream()` will emit a new event for partial function args. We'll open PRs to stable SDK repos right after internal canary. Also planning a short deprecation window for old streaming frame types (90 days after GA).

Samir: Thanks — 90 days OK but can we add an opt-in extended support for enterprise customers that need longer?

Leah: Yes, we'll offer an extended-compat flag and a support add-on for up to 6 months. Customer success will be looped.

Priya: Optimize questions: when do batching suggestions and quantization recommendations land? We heard both in the Q&A but not exact dates.

Leah: Optimize v1: batching/caching suggestion engine in rolling alpha in 2 sprints (internal), public alpha end of month. Quantization recommender (model-specific recommendations and cost delta estimates) targeted Q3. We will publish a short RFC and a sample eval set so customers can validate quality impact.

Diego: Console will ingest Optimize suggestions and surface them as one-click experiments. That integration is planned for the public alpha of Optimize — so expect the Console integration in late-May.

Nina: Heads-up: Optimize's initial anomaly detector will emit alerts for regressions vs baseline prompt sets. Shipping the eval harness is critical before public alpha.

EngOps Bot: deploy-bot: "Canary deploy started: api/gen2-runtime -> cluster-alpha at 1965123465"

Ari: Action items I/O: 1) @Leah to publish a short timeline doc + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Diego to post Console beta invite process and how teams can join. 3) @Nina to open SDK PRs and the deprecation plan. 4) CS & Sales: Leah will share enterprise extended-support offer draft. Please add items to the shared board.

Leah: I'll post the doc in #eng and the public roadmap entry. Also looping @Priya to finalize SLA notes.

Priya: Got it — I'll sync with finance and CS and post a short FAQ for Dedicated/Private customers.

Ari: Thanks all — very helpful. If you asked a question during the panel and don't see it addressed here, drop it and we'll surface it to the owners. :thumbsup:
